en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Toba’ (a Blessed tree in Paradise) is for the one becomes a Muslim and his life was at subsistence level’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Nawfali from al-Sakuni from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
Tuba (a tree in paradise) is for those who have become Muslims and whose expenses are within the limits of bare necessities.”
